notes: Institutional demand is stacked onto residential demand. A pupil counted at home and at school is two access points (home-to-stop and school-to-stop), not a double count of the same trip.

School weights are published Schülerzahlen. Musikschule Gilching lessons are typically weekly and also serve Weßling, Seefeld and Wörthsee, so that site uses a daily-visit estimate rather than full enrollment.
Coordinates are Nominatim/OSM geocodes of the school names or street address.
